subject: Post-call alignment — Meditech pilot scope & SOC2 questions
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood-inference.com>
To: Dr. Elena Vargas <evargas@meditech.ai>, Tom Chen <tchen@meditech.ai>
Date: 2026-08-16T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery — Inference performance, cost, and pilot next steps

Hi Elena / Tom,

Thanks again for carving out time today — great discussion. Wanted to capture the key takeaways and proposed next steps so we have a single reference for procurement and your engineering team. I focused on the items you flagged as blockers for production adoption.

Recap of pain points (what you told us):
- Latency: p95 for document-qa/generative flows is ~700–900ms, with occasional >1s tails on larger documents.
- Cost variability: embedding + generation spikes during batch index/refresh windows, overall token spend ~3x expected for current usage patterns.
- Observability: limited audit logs and token-level cost attribution for HIPAA-sensitive workflows.
- Reliability / fallbacks: limited ability to fail over to cheaper model variants during peak.

Stated goals (short-term):
- Reduce average inference cost by 40–60% for RAG paths while maintaining answer quality.
- Achieve sub-200ms p95 for query-only inference on the most-critical routes.
- Obtain SOC2 evidence and confirm KMS options for PHI.
- Preserve data residency controls and fine-grained audit logs for compliance.

Proposed pilot (what we recommend):
- Dedicated pilot: 2 weeks of Dedicated capacity with telemetry capture (tokens, p95 latency, error rate, cost per 1k tokens).
- Workload: mirror two production routes (document-qa and summarization) and a 48‑hour batch index run to surface spike behavior.
- Success metrics: cost/unit reduction target (>=40%), p95 <200ms for query-only path, complete audit log capture with KMS proof-of-concept.
- Ownership & timeline: Redwood to provision pilot infra; Meditech to provide representative dataset + procurement PO. Target start: week of 2026-08-30.

Immediate next steps (action items):
1) You confirm pilot scope & contacts (procurement & security).
2) We send a draft SOW and a usage export (attached).
3) Schedule a short private deployment demo (30–45m) for your security/infra team.

Attachments: usage_report_Q2.csv (export we used during call), redwood_sow_draft_v1.pdf (starter SOW).

If this looks right, I’ll loop in Monica (CS) and Stephanie (solutions) to draft a Mutual Action Plan and pull SOC2 artifacts.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0123 | dylan.brooks@redwood-inference.com

Subject: Re: Discovery — Inference performance, cost, and pilot next steps

Dylan —

Appreciate the write-up, this matches our notes. A few clarifications / asks from security & procurement before we can commit to the pilot start date:

1) SOC2 / compliance artifacts: can you provide a SOC2 Type II report and a short packet listing the logs/retention we can expect out of the box? Our security team will need to review before the Board sign-off.

2) KMS & key management: does Redwood support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) in the Private offering? We need confirmation of envelope encryption and key rotation policies.

3) Private deployment demo: Sarah (CTO) would like a short demo of the Private/VPC option to understand network boundaries and audit log formats. 30–45 minutes should suffice.

4) Procurement timing: our procurement lead copied here. We have a Board review on 2026-09-14; ideally procurement will have the SOW and pricing by 2026-09-01 to allow internal review cycles.

We can provide a representative dataset and a list of the 10 most-frequent queries for the pilot. Also attaching the security questionnaire we usually ask vendors to fill out (security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx).

Thanks — I’ll coordinate with Tom and Sarah on available slots for the demo.

Warmly,
Elena
Head of AI Products | Meditech AI
elena.vargas@meditech.ai

Subject: Re: Discovery — Inference performance, cost, and pilot next steps

Elena / Tom —

Great — thanks for the clarity. Looping in Monica (Customer Success) and Stephanie (Solutions) to run point on compliance artifacts and pilot runbook. Quick responses to your asks: 

- SOC2 Type II: we’ll share the latest report and a short evidence packet (system diagrams + log types and retention). Monica will own delivery.
- KMS: Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS for the on-prem/VPC deployment; we’ll include KMS architecture notes and rotation policy in the packet.
- Demo: we can do a Private deployment demo the week of 2026-08-24 or 2026-08-31. Proposed slot to Sarah: Aug 25 10:00–10:45 PT (we’ll create a calendar invite once you confirm).

Mutual Action Plan (high level / draft):
1) 8/18 — Redwood shares SOC2 packet + updated SOW (redwood_sow_updated_v2.pdf).
2) 8/25 — Private deployment demo for Sarah + infra team.
3) 8/30 — Pilot provisioning (Dedicated capacity) and data ingestion checklist.
4) 9/13 — Pilot wrap, results review, procurement finalize SOW for Board review 9/14.

Links / artifacts: HubSpot deal MDT-4523 (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/MDT-4523), draft MAP in Google Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_mutual_action_plan).

Best,
Dylan
